current_release_migrations.note: Guarded workflow run 33198354338 stopped before any D1 read/write because CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is not present in GitHub Actions. Publication enforcement activates only after verified Development schema application.
Current Movie authority is movie_catalog plus enriched JSON, not the legacy movies table. The migration stores no image binaries and no secret values.

deferred_it_test_environment.feature_development_assumption: Continue implementing against Development test/provider abstractions as though required key references are populated. Real credential/provider/media acceptance is completed later from the I.T. test environment.

workstreams.scope: Keep Web, Phone and Desktop as active first-class clients of the same responsive/installable application; preserve explicit opt-in notifications, offline/fallback behavior and no idle polling.

New in-house-created products require real raw-inventory lineage and consumption authority before publication; existing products may remain legacy_pending; antiquity, resale and external finished goods can be explicitly inventory-exempt.
Record durable tools and molds used to create products separately from consumable inventory; tool association never consumes the durable tool.

Link materials/tools to normalized manufacturer/vendor provenance and Devil n Dove-authored purchased-item reviews. Support ASIN/external identifiers and safe source/review links; never copy third-party review content or require a marketplace at runtime.

Product Photography Manager overlays the existing Product/media authorities with a transparent 100-point score, catalog-wide work queue, Product-set readiness score, dHash duplicate/near-duplicate flags, best-current-hero and gallery recommendations, explicit reshoot reasons, and optional human approval/rejection. Scoring never deletes images, changes featured media or blocks publication automatically. Optional vision-assisted review remains advisory.

I.T.-owned provider/platform registry for purpose, module consumer, secret/binding reference names only, callbacks/webhooks, scopes, environment, configured/tested state, last safe error and correction mechanics. Actual secrets are forbidden.
Home and Movie cover presentation now reuse one accessible Release 448 carousel authority. Movie records with incomplete cover pairs retain the truthful pending fallback. No extra H1 is introduced.

Current Movie authority is enriched JSON plus movie_catalog D1 overlay. Stable UPC/slug review states represent pending, incomplete, unverified and verified metadata; incorrect values are repaired only with evidence and unknown values are never guessed.
Current and future D1 additions reserve explicit pending, legacy_pending, exempt, unverified, verified and evidence-reference states so unconfirmed workflows never masquerade as proven.

forward_queue: additional top-level modules when ownership boundaries justify them
